record_semantics: This hash-bound file is the project's primary provenance ledger: each record identifies the reviewed external reference and the exact claim used to define accepted answers. It does not assert that every external reference is original historical evidence.
validation_semantics: Runtime validation requires schema version 1, a nonempty records object, string IDs, structurally valid HTTPS URLs, nonempty claims, and a record for every rehearsal or validation-control source_id. It does not fetch URLs or independently establish claim truth.
source_selection_policy: Prefer government, standards-body, museum, educational, and other institutional sources. Modern folklore classifications use editorial dictionary references when original oral or historical evidence cannot define one canonical short answer.

methodology.claim: TRL supports conversational prompt-completion SFT with completion-only loss.
Standard fine-tuning model editing evaluates paraphrase generalization and locality on unedited facts.
Fine-tuning new knowledge can cause forgetting, motivating rehearsal and locality measurement.
QLoRA backpropagates through a frozen four-bit quantized base model into LoRA adapters.
